description: This file is a shell script (with .sh extension) that contains a series of test cases for verifying the behavior of Git commands, particularly focusing on `git add -u`, `git diff-files`, `git diff-index`, and related repository state changes. It includes setup, modifications, and assertions to validate Git's handling of various file operations, symlinks, submodules, and file states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a given test scenario.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of specific prerequisites required for tests, like symlinks support.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Records the current timestamp or state for use in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output in tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
